_comment: Expected structural variance — forms that are structurally different from peers by design, not error.

expected_outliers.reason: Saturday EP has extra liturgical content (longer structure)
Saturday EP has additional leader segments
Saturday EP litany is longer than weekday EPs
Sunday MP has additional navigation rubrics
Easter MP has seasonal liturgical variations
Easter EP has seasonal liturgical variations

Easter EP is the longest seasonal EP and became an outlier without changing: deleting the Epiphany EP doxologies per Seasonal errata p. 52 took that form from 51 to 45 segments, lowering the seasonal-EP peer mean and tightening the spread. No correction touches Easter EP itself.
All Saints litany is longer than other seasonal MP forms

Passiontide EP prints the responsory transition as one paragraph (its page lines end with ~0pt gap, so the reflow correctly joins '...or both.' and 'If two Readings are read...' into a single rubric); every other seasonal EP sets them as two. One fewer rubric segment, no text missing (#84).
